## Change summary

Describe the model, prompt, policy, dataset, metric, or platform change.

## Risk and evidence

- [ ] Dataset and prompt/policy versions are recorded.
- [ ] Deterministic tests pass.
- [ ] Reference evaluation and release gate pass.
- [ ] Safety, privacy, latency, and cost impact were reviewed.
- [ ] Regression comparison is attached when behavior changed.
- [ ] Human approval is recorded for consequential changes.

## Validation

List commands, results, artifacts, and any conditions or limitations.
